map.为什么中英文混排对不齐？: Why does mixed Chinese and English text not align?
map.中文按字宽、英文单词按整体宽度，两端对齐需在中文字间插空格、英文保持词完整，混排: Chinese is measured by character width and English words by whole-word width, so justification inserts spaces between Chinese characters while keeping English words intact; with mixed text the calculation differs, and some tools only distribute space evenly between characters.
